Initialize a LOGOS project in the current directory.

Similar to [`New`][Commands::New] but works in an existing directory. Creates the manifest and source structure without creating a new folder.

# Example

```bash mkdir my_project && cd my_project largo init ```

Usage: largo init [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --name <NAME>
          Project name. If omitted, uses the current directory name

  -q, --quiet
          Suppress informational output (errors still print)

  -v, --verbose...
          Increase output verbosity (repeatable)

      --color <WHEN>
          When to use terminal colors

          Possible values:
          - auto:   Color when stdout/stderr is a terminal and `NO_COLOR` is unset
          - always: Always emit ANSI, even into pipes (CI logs, `less -R`)
          - never:  Never emit ANSI
          
          [default: auto]

  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')

Examples:
  mkdir app && cd app
  largo init
  largo init --name my_app
